notFound: This global variable does not exist or you may not view it.

CONSTANT.label: Constant
CONSTANT.hint: Only users change it. Workflows read it.

MUTABLE.label: Mutable
MUTABLE.hint: Its owner workflow changes it during runs. Other workflows read it.

SCRIPT.label: Script
SCRIPT.hint: A shared function that returns a value each time it is called.

list.title: Global Variables
list.subTitle: Values defined once and referenced by name in workflows, connectors and notifications.

live.beingUpdatedHint: The owner workflow is writing this variable (started {{startedAt}}). The value shown is the last saved one.
live.beingUpdatedStarting: Being updated by a starting run

kind.label: Kind
kind.hint: The kind can't be changed after the variable is created.
kind.lockedHint: The kind was chosen when the variable was created and can't change.

errors.pattern: Use 1 to 64 letters, digits or _, starting with a letter.
errors.taken: A global variable with this name already exists.

secret.label: Secret
secret.hint: A secret value is never shown again after saving and is masked in logs.

value.label: Value
value.hint: Text, a number, true or false, a JSON list or a JSON map.
value.savedAs: Saved as {{type}}. Wrap numbers or true/false in quotes to keep them as text.
value.secretHint: Enter the secret value. It can't be shown again after saving.
value.secretKeptHint: Leave empty to keep the stored value, or enter a new one to replace it.

errors.tooLarge: The value is larger than 64 KB.

scope.label: Visibility
scope.hint: Which workflows may use this variable. Connectors can only use variables visible to all workflows.

errors.noTarget: Choose at least one category or workflow.

create.subheader: Define a value once and use it in any workflow, connector or notification.

update.subheader: Changes apply to runs that start after saving. Runs already going keep the old value.

general.subheader: Choose the kind and name the variable.

value.subheader: Set the value workflows read, or the code a script runs.

visibility.subheader: Choose which workflows may use the variable.

save.failed: The global variable could not be saved.
save.kindNotEditableYet: Variables of this kind can't be edited here yet.
save.noEditPermission: You may not edit this global variable.

warnings.title: This change may affect these places

blocked.title: This change would break these places
blocked.IN_USE: The variable is still in use
blocked.SCOPE_NARROWING: The new visibility excludes workflows that use the variable
blocked.PARAMETER_BREAKING: The parameter change breaks these callers
blocked.BUSY: A workflow that uses the variable is running; try again when it has finished

versionConflict.title: Someone else saved first
versionConflict.message: {{detail}}. Reload to see the current value, then make your change again.

reason.OUT_OF_SCOPE: Would no longer be allowed to use the variable
reason.PARAMETER_BREAKING: Calls the script with parameters that would no longer fit
reason.CALLS_IN_CODE_NOT_CHECKED: Calls inside its code can't be checked automatically

delete.noPermission: You may not delete this global variable
delete.failed: The global variable could not be deleted.

confirm.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
confirm.message: Global variable "{{name}}" will be deleted. This can't be undone.
confirm.messageWithWarnings: Nothing uses the variable any more, but check these places first:

blocked.title: "{{name}}" can't be deleted
blocked.message: It is still used here. Remove these references first:

changes.restoreFailed: The earlier version could not be restored.

restoreConfirm.title: Restore this version?
restoreConfirm.message: The value from version {{version}} becomes the current value. This is logged as a new change.
restoreConfirm.messageMutable: The value from version {{version}} becomes the initial value. Reset afterwards to make it the current value. This is logged as a new change.

sharing.owner: Owner: {{name}}. The owner and admins can always use, edit and delete it.

picker.empty: No global variables you may use here
picker.unknown: Unknown global variable, or one you may not use

referenceErrors.OUT_OF_SCOPE: Global variable "{{variable}}" is not visible to this workflow.
referenceErrors.SCOPE_NOT_ALL: Connectors can only use global variables visible to all workflows ("{{variable}}").
referenceErrors.NO_USE_PERMISSION: You may not use global variable "{{variable}}".
referenceErrors.INVALID_WRITE_TARGET: A write target must be exactly global.<name> ("{{field}}").
referenceErrors.NOT_MUTABLE: "{{variable}}" is not a mutable variable, so it can't be written.
referenceErrors.NOT_OWNER: Global variable "{{variable}}" belongs to another workflow; only its owner workflow may write it.
referenceErrors.SCRIPT_NOT_CALLABLE: "{{variable}}" is a script: import it in a transformation of its language and call it there.
referenceErrors.IMPORT_LANGUAGE_MISMATCH: "{{variable}}" is written in another language than this transformation.

script.languageLocked: The language can't change after the script is created.
script.codeHint: Must return a value. A script uses only its parameters: it cannot read or write workflow data with ref() or set().

parameters.label: Parameters
parameters.hint: Every call fills exactly these parameters. An optional parameter left empty uses its default.
parameters.name: Parameter name

errors.tooLarge: The script is larger than 256 KB.
errors.parameters: Parameter names must be unique identifiers (letters, digits, _ or $, not starting with a digit).
errors.SCRIPT_NOT_PURE: A script uses only its parameters, so it cannot call ref() or set()
errors.LANGUAGE_NOT_SUPPORTED: Scripts are written in JavaScript, Python 3 or Ruby
errors.MISSING_ARGUMENT: A required parameter has no test argument
errors.SCRIPT_ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE: The script engine for this language is not reachable
errors.VALIDATION_UNAVAILABLE: Checking scripts in this language is not available yet

test.argumentMissing: Not passed: an optional parameter uses its default, a required one fails the run.

busyPolicy.label: When a run of a workflow that uses it is still going

hints.QUEUE: The next run waits and starts when the running one ends.
hints.REFUSE: The next run does not start and is logged as failed.

owner.label: Owner workflow
owner.hint: The only workflow whose runs may write this variable. It must be inside the scope.

errors.ownerRequired: Choose the workflow whose runs may write this variable.

general.subheader: Owner, version and the latest change
general.description: Who owns the variable, its current version, and when it was created and last changed. For mutable and secret variables, the stored value too.

usage.subheader: Workflows, connectors and notifications that use it
usage.description: Every place that refers to this variable: workflow steps, connectors and notifications. The access column shows whether it reads or writes the variable, or imports a script into a transformation.

changes.description: Each saved or rejected change to the value, settings or sharing, with who made it. Restore an earlier value from its row.

sharing.subheader: Users who may use, edit or delete it
sharing.description: Give other users access to this variable. Use lets them reference it in their workflows; Edit and Delete add the matching rights. Changes apply once you save.

confirm.title: Reset the current value?
confirm.message: The current value is replaced by the initial value {{value}}. Runs that start afterwards read it. This is logged as a reset.

reset.failed: The current value could not be reset.
